new_libraries.name: QDY30A_RS485
new_libraries.author: Renzo Mischianti <renzo.mischianti@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Library for fluid level measurement using the QDY30A RS485 level transmitter with Modbus RTU protocol. Compatible with Arduino, STM32, ESP8266, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi Pico.
new_libraries.paragraph: QDY30A_RS485 is designed to simplify the integration and communication with the QDY30A level transmitter over RS485 using the Modbus RTU protocol. It supports a wide range of microcontrollers including Arduino, STM32, ESP8266, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi Pico, making it versatile for various fluid level measurement projects.

library.name: UARDECS_ESP32C3
library.author: Takehiko Hoshi, Hideto Kurosaki and Ken-ichro Yasuba
library.sentence: A library that provides communication capabilities compliant with the "Ubiquitous Environment Control System (UECS)" standard, which is widely used in protected horticulture in Japan.
library.paragraph: This library facilitates UECS sweet application development on the ESP32C3 chip board by providing UDP packet broadcast communication via Wi-Fi and internet web server functionality, all compliant with the UECS communication protocol. It supports the ESP32C3-OLED, XIAO ESP32C3, and compatible boards. Version 1.0.1 improves the stability of HTTP reception. Please refer to LICENSE.md for licensing information. Version 1.0.2 improves to avoid processing slow down, changed timing to retry failed WiFi connection from every sending time to every a minute.
